summary: CHURN WATCH — two of the four exit signals are now present. (a) Quiet and short: the chat was completely silent from Sep 18 01:34 to Sep 28 15:47 (ten days, zero messages from anyone, which is why Mila had no 2026-09-25 report), and this window Callie wrote exactly two messages, both the same two-word reply 'Done:)'. Two weeks ago she was asking questions and thanking people by name; this week she did not thank Mica for the inspo drop and raised nothing. (b) Unusually fast payment with zero asks: the Sep 15-30 invoice was posted Oct 1 15:14 and she replied 'Done:)' at 18:18 — 3h04m, the fastest payment in the relationship (previous best was two days), with no question about the amount, the currency, the banking details or the four earlier cycles ALTR has never confirmed. No asks for exports/logins and no mention of another agency or going it alone. ALTR side: no progress on any open item. Nobody sent the reconciliation message flagged as the top action two weeks ago; the Sep 17 payment is now 15 days unconfirmed and a seventh invoice went out on top of five unconfirmed cycles (last receipt confirmation Jul 23, 71 days). Her main Instagram account is 101 days open with no ALTR update; Derrek has not posted since Sep 16. The two deliverables this week were Mica's reel-inspo drop (Sep 29, one weekly drop missed, one duplicate link) and Melissa's agency-wide intake-form broadcast (Sep 28), which Callie most likely completed — her 'Done:)' at 17:20 Sep 29 is not threaded to either message. Not angry or disputing anything, just doing the minimum and asking nothing. That is the churn pattern, not stability.

Every structural problem from the last report is unchanged and older: five invoice cycles unconfirmed (Jul 15-31 52d since 'Will update you shortly!', Aug 17 wire 46d, Aug 15-31 24d past due and unmentioned since Sep 1, Sep 17 payment 15d, Oct 1 payment 1d); main IG account 101 days with no owner update; Derrek's rollout promise 62 days overdue; Vivek has never posted (65d); Michelle silent 46 days with post links 86 days overdue and 48 videos unused for 46 days; Mayson's accepted call 25 days unbooked. Not lower because she is still paying instantly, still completing ALTR asks (intake form, likely), and Mica's inspo cadence resumed. A fast-paying, silent client with this many unanswered items should be read as a client winding down, not a healthy one.
